journey-bio1: I am a Systems Analyst and Full-Stack Developer. I turn complex workflows and disconnected platforms into digital products that reach production.
journey-bio2: I work end to end: discovery, architecture, development, data migration, infrastructure and training. My technical core is Python, Django, FastAPI, Odoo and JavaScript.
journey-bio3: I specialize in institutional environments where traceability, operational continuity and user adoption matter as much as the code.
experience-context: Institutional experience and freelance engagements. Dates show the duration of each relationship and may overlap.
exp1-company: Professional Council of Economic Sciences of Salta
exp1-b1: Business process analysis and requirements gathering with the involved areas.
exp1-b2: Migration, consolidation and sanitization of more than one million records from three legacy systems.
exp1-b3: Contributed to the architecture and development of more than 30 Odoo modules for professional services, legalizations and accounting management.
exp1-b4: Worked within a team of eight technical specialists and one Product Manager, taking coordination responsibility at different stages.
exp2-b1: End-to-end creation of an intranet and app for approximately 30 employees across administration, nursing, pharmacy and billing.
exp2-b2: Digitization of internal workflows and medication traceability from nursing tablets.
exp2-b3: Read-only integration with Geclisa through FastAPI, without modifying information in the clinical system.
exp2-b4: Django, React Native/Expo and Firebase Authentication architecture restricted to the institutional LAN through MikroTik.
exp3-b1: Technical owner of the first stage of a gradual migration from Zeus to Odoo across four business units.
exp3-b2: Migrated and validated more than 100,000 records covering approximately six years of operations.
exp3-b3: The only IT specialist in a four-person team, responsible for execution and technical decisions.
exp3-b4: Adapted and created modules, designed the website and implemented the solution on Odoo.sh while both systems coexist.
